title: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 6 (Requirements for Research Institutions): The head of the Office for National Affairs Coordination shall designate a research institution as one of the following, provided that the institution possesses experts or an organization with expertise in conflict management:

1. Research institutions established in accordance with the "Act on the Establishment, Operation, and Promotion of Government-Funded Research Institutions, etc."
2. Research institutes established within schools as defined in Article 2 of the "Act on Higher Education."
3. Non-profit organizations or their affiliated research institutes as defined in Article 32 of the "Civil Code."
4. Corporate-affiliated research institutes.
